summary: These tables report institution-level activity over a 12-month period, using either July 1, 2005–June 30, 2006 or September 1, 2005–August 31, 2006, at the institution’s option. The survey covers undergraduate and graduate enrollment or instructional activity at participating IPEDS institutions. In 2006, 12-month enrollment was still collected on the Fall Enrollment survey form; the separate 12-month collection began in 2007.

Fall Enrollment covers institutions participating in IPEDS that report students enrolled during the fall, with institution-level records often repeated for student subgroups. Traditional academic-year institutions report enrollment as of October 15 or their official fall reporting date; institutions with program-specific or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. The survey includes institution-reported fall enrollment, but some components are restricted to particular institution types or undergraduate populations, and optional components may be unavailable for some institutions.

Finance collects institution-level financial information in the 2006-07 collection cycle for fiscal year 2006, using each institution’s applicable fiscal-year reporting period rather than a calendar-year period. The universe is postsecondary institutions eligible or required to report to IPEDS, with reporting organized by the institution’s accounting basis; public GASB institutions, FASB institutions, and private for-profit institutions use different forms. Data are reported at the institution level and cover revenues, expenditures, assets, liabilities, and related financial information, with public GASB institutions reporting component units separately where applicable.

This annual survey reports institution-level outcomes for cohorts of full-time, first-time, degree- or certificate-seeking undergraduate students, with status measured as of August 31 of the survey year. It covers eligible institutions and records completion and transfer outcomes relative to 150% of normal time; the applicable cohort and institution sector determine which students are included.

These Human Resources tables cover institution-level staff information for Fall 2006, generally using the November 1 payroll snapshot; salary and benefits tables cover academic year 2006-07. Records are reported by institution and repeated for occupational, employment, demographic, contract, rank, tenure, or benefit categories, with eligibility varying by table across degree-granting, nondegree-granting, institution-size, and institutional-sector populations. Some tables have optional race/ethnicity and gender reporting in even-numbered years, so coverage is incomplete where that rule applies.

The Institutional Characteristics survey is collected in the fall for the 2006-07 academic year and reports institution-level characteristics, offerings, services, admissions, and student charges according to the institution’s academic calendar or program structure. The universe is every institution in the 2006 IPEDS universe; active Title IV-participating institutions are required to report, and institutions may use parent/child reporting arrangements. Applicability varies by institution, including whether it has open admissions, uses an academic-year or program-based calendar, and offers the relevant student or professional programs.
